renderer_scope: New independent CPU triangle rasterizer with perspective-correct nearest skin sampling and actor-only z-buffer. First person uses a purpose-built projection/pose, not an original first-person matrix port. View 1 is a third-person character preview over the still-first-person world image, NOT a true tracking camera; no world depth/occlusion or camera changes. The original hat layer is entirely transparent and is omitted. No original HumanoidModel/PlayerRenderer function is compiled.
